status: Lookahead scheduler implementation; latest measured outcome is in result/latest.json.
candidate_rule: 6 x 5 rounded grid spanning x=4..93,y=4..60; all directed pairs checked by Nav2
sampling_window: Ticks 1..299 in [0,300); no fabricated catch-up samples.
internal_search_horizon: 300 - elapsed simulation time; free endpoint via zero-cost virtual terminal. No return requirement.
initial_gp: 980 available real observations with fixed saved RBF hyperparameters; translation only; mission starts one second after last recorded time
srf: Existing fixed Matern RandMeth realization and independent noise; Python query node
video: rosbag physical-pose replay; not a Gazebo GUI screen recording
limitations: Temporary map translation is not surveyed real-map registration
Finite path travel-time model does not explicitly predict turn/acceleration timing
One scene/seed; guarded GRG search may time out and return best-so-far; check actual route coverage and counts.
GUI render FPS is not measured
Lookahead uses the last committed GP. Activation re-scores the candidate with new data but does not repeat complete route selection. Prediction errors and waiting for late plans remain possible.
scoring_compute_mode: batched uncached event features; evaluation-grid step configured separately
matrix_parallelism: OpenMP linked into both C++ executables; bounded Eigen threads before GP construction; selected by matched 1/2/4-thread check
gp_update_mode: Initial/activation requests seal actual observations; moving lookahead freezes the committed GP and leaves the current-leg data buffered.
handover_mode: One active Nav2 goal; future-anchor candidate is checked by request ID and endpoint, then rescored with actual time and updated GP after arrival.
arrival_estimate: Nav2 estimated_time_remaining with nominal path-time fallback and distance/speed lower bound; forecast is revalidated at arrival.
